AccessKey.description: An engine-issued key, as inspected. The token itself is never stored or returned again.
AccessKey.title: AccessKey

Allowance.description: The allocation as the provider reports it. A cap that can overshoot: funds are not reserved.
Allowance.title: Allowance

Attempt.description: One runner call. Written as ``in_flight`` before the call, updated after it.
Attempt.title: Attempt

GrantRecord.description: A Batteries grant the operator can fund actors from.
GrantRecord.title: GrantRecord

MeasuredUsage.description: Work done, in units the capability defines. Retains its source and is never equated with cost.
MeasuredUsage.title: MeasuredUsage

Money-Input.description: An exact amount in one currency. Serialized as a decimal string, never a float.
Money-Input.title: Money

Money-Output.description: An exact amount in one currency. Serialized as a decimal string, never a float.
Money-Output.title: Money

NetworkRate.description: A rate as the orchestrator advertises it (wholesale network price, not retail).
NetworkRate.title: NetworkRate

Offering.description: One runner app, as a builder sees it.
Offering.title: Offering

Reconciliation.description: Batteries spent = delivered + failed_after_payment + uncertain + unattributed (per allocation).
Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation

ResultRef.description: Where a result lives. M2 keeps immediate results inline (not retained) and records their shape.
ResultRef.title: ResultRef

SecretRef.description: A handle to a secret held by a SecretStore. Databases, records and logs hold only this.
SecretRef.title: SecretRef

Session.description: A persistent runner session. The engine proxies all traffic; clients never see the app URL.
Session.title: Session

200.description: The runner's own status, content type and body
